Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely treated Wikipedia’s locality (“Weston-under-Lizard”) as the likely death place instead of distinguishing the specific estate (“Weston Park”) within that locality. This misinterpretation of place granularity (estate vs. village/parish) and early preference for the Wikipedia infobox, without prioritizing authoritative genealogical sources (e.g., ThePeerage/Complete Peerage), steered the solution toward the wrong form of the answer.
